# Environment variables

Every variable is optional: the defaults are a working configuration. The server reads
them once at startup. "If invalid" says what happens to a value it does not accept.
The list is checked against the code by a docs test, so a variable the server reads
cannot be missing here.

## Core

| Variable                  | Default                         | Accepts                                | If invalid    | Purpose                                                                                                                                                                | Read in                                                                         |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `VOLTRA_ADAPTER`          | `node`                          | `node` \| `mock`                       | stops startup | Which device adapter to use. `mock` runs an in-process simulated device and adds the `mock.*` tools.                                                                   | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |
| `VMCP_DB_PATH`            | `~/.voltras/vmcp.sqlite`        | file path                              | not checked   | The SQLite store for sessions, sets and plans. Give each server that runs at the same time its own path.                                                               | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |
| `VMCP_SLOT_BINDINGS_PATH` | `~/.voltras/slot-bindings.json` | file path                              | not checked   | Where the saved left and right device bindings of the `slot.*` tools live.                                                                                             | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |
| `VMCP_LOG_LEVEL`          | `info`                          | `debug` \| `info` \| `warn` \| `error` | not checked   | Log verbosity. Logs go to stderr, because stdout carries the MCP transport.                                                                                            | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |
| `VMCP_MOUNT_RATING_LBS`   | _unset_                         | positive number                        | stops startup | The load rating of the anchor mount, in pounds. Isometric and eccentric-overload peaks above it are refused; unset means unknown, not unlimited, and those tools warn. | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |

## Dashboard and voice

| Variable              | Default           | Accepts                     | If invalid       | Purpose                                                                                                                                   | Read in                                                                               |
| --------------------- | ----------------- | --------------------------- | ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `VMCP_DASHBOARD_PORT` | `7723`            | port number \| `off` \| `0` | uses the default | Port of the local dashboard. `off` or `0` turns it off. A busy port falls back to one the OS picks, so read the URL from `server.health`. | [src/server.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/server.ts)       |
| `VMCP_CUES`           | `off`             | `off` \| `on`               | stops startup    | Spoken coaching cues at set boundaries, macOS only. A startup default: `system.set_cues` changes it at runtime.                           | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts)       |
| `VMCP_CUES_MIDSET`    | `off`             | `off` \| `on`               | stops startup    | Lets the cues that fire while the lifter is under load speak too. A startup default: `system.set_cues` changes it at runtime.             | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts)       |
| `VOLTRAS_EFFORT_CUE`  | `off`             | `off` \| `on`               | stops startup    | Lets the effort rule choose the one mid-set ending cue and store a cue record with the set. Off until it is validated on a device.        | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts)       |
| `VOLTRAS_VAD_MODEL`   | the bundled model | file path                   | uses the default | Replaces the voice-activity model that `system.listen_start` uses. A path that does not exist is ignored.                                 | [src/voice/vad.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/voice/vad.ts) |

## Recording

| Variable                | Default     | Accepts                   | If invalid    | Purpose                                                                                                                               | Read in                                                                         |
| ----------------------- | ----------- | ------------------------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `VMCP_AUTO_ARM`         | `on`        | `off` \| `on`             | stops startup | Reps during an open session with no open set open a set and count into it. `off` reports those reps as idle reps only.                | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |
| `VMCP_REST_TIMER`       | `off`       | `off` \| `on`             | stops startup | Starts the rest-status push cycle when a set closes on its own. Never started when `session.end` closes the set.                      | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |
| `VMCP_REP_SOURCE`       | `analytics` | `analytics` \| `firmware` | stops startup | Which rep pipeline reads draw from. `firmware` is not yet validated on a device; see the [roadmap](/roadmap).                         | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |
| `VMCP_REP_UNRACK_DROP`  | `off`       | `off` \| `on`             | stops startup | Drops the un-rack artifact rep when a set closes. Off until validated across movement types, because it changes the stored rep count. | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |
| `VMCP_REP_ECC_TRUNCATE` | `on`        | `off` \| `on`             | stops startup | Trims the idle tail off the last rep's lowering phase when a set closes. It deletes no rep.                                           | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |
| `VMCP_REP_CORRECTIONS`  | _unset_     | `off` \| `on`             | stops startup | Legacy switch that sets the two variables above together. Either one set on its own wins over it.                                     | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |

## Diagnostics

| Variable                 | Default               | Accepts          | If invalid       | Purpose                                                                                                 | Read in                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------ | --------------------- | ---------------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `VMCP_DEBUG_BUFFER_SIZE` | `256`                 | positive integer | uses the default | Capacity of the in-memory buffer behind `debug.recent_frames` and `debug.recent_events`.                | [src/state/debug-buffer.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/state/debug-buffer.ts)         |
| `VMCP_RECORD_SESSION`    | _unset_               | `1` \| `true`    | not checked      | Turns on a local capture of the device session for offline replay. `debug.recording_status` reports it. | [src/state/session-recorder.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/state/session-recorder.ts) |
| `VMCP_CAPTURE_DIR`       | `~/.voltras/captures` | directory path   | not checked      | Where the session capture is written. Keep it outside any repository.                                   | [src/state/session-recorder.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/state/session-recorder.ts) |

## TrueCoach

| Variable                       | Default                           | Accepts        | If invalid    | Purpose                                                                                                                                       | Read in                                                                         |
| ------------------------------ | --------------------------------- | -------------- | ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `VMCP_TRUECOACH_USERNAME`      | _unset_                           | email          | not checked   | TrueCoach account email for `truecoach.import_week`.                                                                                          | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |
| `VMCP_TRUECOACH_PASSWORD`      | _unset_                           | string         | not checked   | TrueCoach password, in plaintext. Prefer `VMCP_TRUECOACH_PASSWORD_CMD`.                                                                       | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |
| `VMCP_TRUECOACH_PASSWORD_CMD`  | _unset_                           | shell command  | not checked   | A command that prints the password, so the secret can stay in the macOS keychain. Wins over `VMCP_TRUECOACH_PASSWORD`.                        | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |
| `VMCP_TRUECOACH_CLIENT_ID`     | the id from the sign-in response  | string         | not checked   | Overrides the TrueCoach client id the pull reads.                                                                                             | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |
| `VMCP_TRUECOACH_TOKEN_PATH`    | `~/.voltras/truecoach-token.json` | file path      | not checked   | Cached access token, readable by the owner only.                                                                                              | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |
| `VMCP_TRUECOACH_CACHE_DIR`     | `~/.voltras/truecoach-cache`      | directory path | not checked   | Cache of raw TrueCoach responses.                                                                                                             | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |
| `VMCP_TRUECOACH_OUTBOX`        | `off`                             | `off` \| `on`  | stops startup | `session.end` writes the session's coach results to a local outbox file. Nothing is uploaded.                                                 | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |
| `VMCP_TRUECOACH_OUTBOX_DIR`    | `~/.voltras/truecoach-outbox`     | directory path | not checked   | Root directory of the outbox.                                                                                                                 | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |
| `VMCP_TRUECOACH_SUBMIT_ON_END` | `off`                             | `off` \| `on`  | stops startup | With the outbox on, each written entry also starts one unattended submit to TrueCoach. Read the README section on TrueCoach write-back first. | [src/config.ts](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/src/config.ts) |
